posts.text:
Journalist and activist Mahdieh Golroo: “Whatever they do, they can’t remove those two half-finished and asymmetrical minarets from the frame. A symbol of the inefficiency and corruption of the early Khamenei era, a project that began in 1990, roughly coinciding with the start of his leadership and remains unfinished. An endless pit for wasting resources and for further corruption and rent-seeking.”


مهدیه گلرو (@mahdieh_golroo)
